The sk-git skill fails its package size gate
findingDetails.evidence: validate_skill_package.py exited 1 and reported 5038 words against the 5000-word cap; README verification currently says the check reports PASS.
findingDetails.recommendation: Trim SKILL.md below 5000 words and rerun the package validator before release.
findingDetails.scopeProof: SKILL.md and the README are listed in the bound review manifest.

findingDetails.title: The skill playbook summary reports an obsolete scenario range and category count
findingDetails.evidence: The skill says GIT-001..GIT-042 across 8 categories; the playbook validator reports 46 scenarios and 9 categories, and GIT-044 through GIT-046 appear in the index.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update the summary range and category count to match the package inventory.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The skill and playbook index are listed in the bound review manifest.

findingDetails.title: The playbook validation example cannot run as written
findingDetails.evidence: The command runs a Python validator through bash and combines a repository-root validator path with a skill-relative target path, so no single working directory resolves both.
findingDetails.recommendation: Invoke the validator with Python and make both paths relative to one declared working directory.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The skill is listed in the bound review manifest.

findingDetails.title: The playbook wave plan double-books GIT-042 and omits GIT-044 through GIT-046
findingDetails.evidence: Wave 5 includes GIT-042 in its inclusive range, wave 6 assigns GIT-042 again, and indexed scenarios GIT-044 through GIT-046 occur in no suggested wave.
findingDetails.recommendation: Assign each scenario to one wave and add GIT-044 through GIT-046 to the plan.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The playbook index is listed in the bound review manifest.

findingDetails.title: The skill prose has widespread HVR punctuation blockers
findingDetails.evidence: HVR scan reports 61 hard punctuation findings and 314 mechanical deductions across 579 lines, a density of 54.2 deductions per 100 lines under the long-document rule.
findingDetails.recommendation: Revise authored prose to remove prohibited punctuation, then rerun the scan and assess the long-document density.
findingDetails.scopeProof: SKILL.md is listed in the bound review manifest.

findingDetails.title: The playbook index has widespread HVR punctuation blockers
findingDetails.evidence: HVR scan reports 53 hard punctuation findings and 268 mechanical deductions across 1024 lines, a density of 26.2 deductions per 100 lines under the long-document rule.
findingDetails.recommendation: Revise authored prose to remove prohibited punctuation and rerun the scan.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The playbook index is listed in the bound review manifest.

findingDetails.title: The README repeats the worktree reaper outcome
findingDetails.evidence: The row says “Keeps the rest and keeps and reports the rest,” repeating the outcome and obscuring the report-only behavior.
findingDetails.recommendation: State once that qualifying wrapper worktrees are reaped and all other worktrees are reported without removal.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The README is listed in the bound review manifest.
